shortDescription: Create or cancel a virtual instance in SoftLayer

options.name: cpus
options.description: Count of cpus to be assigned to new virtual instance.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: Datacenter for the virtual instance to be deployed.

options.name: dedicated
options.description: Flag to determine if the instance should be deployed in dedicated space.

options.name: disks
options.description: List of disk sizes to be assigned to new virtual instance.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain name to be provided to a virtual instance.

options.name: flavor
options.description: Specify which SoftLayer flavor template to use instead of cpus and memory.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Hostname to be provided to a virtual instance.

options.name: hourly
options.description: Flag to determine if the instance should be hourly billed.

options.name: image_id
options.description: Image Template to be used for new virtual instance.

options.name: instance_id
options.description: Instance ID of the virtual instance to perform action option.

options.name: local_disk
options.description: Flag to determine if local disk should be used for the new instance.

options.name: memory
options.description: Amount of memory to be assigned to new virtual instance.

options.name: nic_speed
options.description: NIC Speed to be assigned to new virtual instance.

options.name: os_code
options.description: OS Code to be used for new virtual instance.

options.name: post_uri
options.description: URL of a post provisioning script to be loaded and executed on virtual instance.

options.name: private
options.description: Flag to determine if the instance should be private only.

options.name: private_vlan
options.description: VLAN by its ID to be assigned to the private NIC.

options.name: public_vlan
options.description: VLAN by its ID to be assigned to the public NIC.

options.name: ssh_keys
options.description: List of ssh keys by their ID to be assigned to a virtual instance.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, or cancel a virtual instance. Specify V(present) for create, V(absent) to cancel.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tag or list of tags to be provided to a virtual instance.

options.name: wait
options.description: Flag used to wait for active status before returning.

options.name: wait_time
options.description: Time in seconds before wait returns.
